1. APPLICATION DESCRIPTION
Card Connect;
Is a mobile application that scans business card images via the camera,
Analyzes the information on business cards using OCR (Optical Character Recognition) and Artificial Intelligence / LLM technologies,
Accesses the user’s contacts data with the user’s permission,
And performs AI-powered smart grouping and tagging.

2. LICENSE SCOPE
The user is granted the right to use the application:
For personal and non-commercial purposes,
Under a non-transferable, non-exclusive, and limited license.
Reverse engineering, copying, selling, or unauthorized distribution of the application is strictly prohibited.

3. COLLECTED DATA
The application processes the following data only with explicit user consent:
3.1 Data Provided by the User
Business card images
Information on the business card such as name, surname, phone number, email, and company details
Manually entered notes and tags
3.2 Automatically Processed Data
Text extracted via OCR
Classifications and groupings generated by artificial intelligence
Application performance, usage behaviors, and error logs collected via Firebase Analytics and Firebase Crashlytics (anonymous)
3.3 Contacts Data
Access to contacts is provided only with user permission
Contacts data is not shared with third parties outside the user’s device

4. PURPOSE OF DATA PROCESSING
Collected data is processed for the following purposes:
Digitization of business card information
Smart grouping and analysis
Improvement of user experience
Error resolution, app performance, and usage analysis
Data is not used for purposes other than those stated.

5. USER RIGHTS UNDER KVKK (LAW NO. 6698)
Pursuant to Article 11 of KVKK, the user has the right to:
Learn whether personal data is being processed
Request information if personal data has been processed
Request correction of incomplete or inaccurate data
Request deletion or destruction of personal data
Withdraw explicit consent at any time

6. USER RIGHTS UNDER GDPR
For users within the European Union:
Right to Access
Right to Rectification
Right to Erasure – Right to be Forgotten
Right to Data Portability
Right to Object
These rights are guaranteed.

7. DATA RETENTION AND SECURITY
Data is retained only for the necessary period
Industry-standard encryption and security measures are applied
Technical and administrative measures are taken against unauthorized access

8. USE OF ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE AND OCR
OCR and LLM outputs are automated analyses and 100% accuracy is not guaranteed
The user is responsible for reviewing the generated data
AI-generated outputs do not have legal or commercial binding

9. THIRD-PARTY SERVICES
The application may use reliable third-party services such as:
OCR
Artificial intelligence models
Google Firebase Analytics and Firebase Crashlytics to monitor user interactions and analyze app crashes
These services collect data such as device information, in-app behavior, and crash logs anonymously. These services access only the minimum data required.

10. DISCLAIMER
The application is provided “as is.”
The company shall not be held liable for data loss, incorrect analysis, or indirect damages.

11. AMENDMENTS TO THE AGREEMENT
This Agreement may be updated. Updates become effective once published within the application.

12. GOVERNING LAW
This Agreement is subject to the laws of the Republic of Turkey.
The courts of Düzce shall have jurisdiction in case of disputes.

13. CONTACT
For data requests and legal inquiries:
📧 Email: info@cardconnect.app
